description: Venues deliberately held outside automatic admission. A hold is a safe, respected outcome: the next package can revisit it. Admitting any of these on present evidence would risk a canonical duplicate.

venues.name: AMT Headingley Rugby Stadium
venues.disposition_basis: Package 08 identity decision: evidence does not settle this venue's identity.
venues.package08_reasoning: Unlike the Newcastle/Sheffield pair, postcode does not decide this one -- the rugby stadium and cricket ground genuinely share one site. But they are documented as two separately owned, separately operated, separately-capacitied grounds, not one venue. The row's name and capacity (19,700) correctly describe the rugby stadium, but its programme_url (yorkshireccc.com/events) is the cricket club's own events page for the sibling ground, not the rugby stadium's. This is the row's name saying one venue while its evidence says another -- the exact pattern the brief flags for a hold rather than a rescue, since admitting the row would attach Yorkshire CCC's programme source to the rugby stadium's identity.

venues.name: Liverpool Experience Campus
venues.disposition_basis: Package 08 identity decision: evidence does not settle this venue's identity.
venues.package08_reasoning: The row's name (Liverpool Experience Campus) is the parent operator/campus brand, not a single physical venue with one capacity -- but its capacity and programme_url are both specific to one component venue, M&S Bank Arena, which the corpus separately holds as its own record per the brief. This is the row's name saying one thing (an umbrella campus) and its evidence saying another (one specific arena within it) -- exactly the 'parent complex duplicating its own arena' pattern the brief asked to check for, confirmed. Held rather than admitted, since admitting 'Liverpool Experience Campus' as a single ≥1,000-capacity venue would either duplicate the M&S Bank Arena record or mis-state the campus (which is not itself a single bookable space) as one.

venues.name: Newcastle Greyhound Stadium
venues.disposition_basis: Package 08 identity decision: evidence does not settle this venue's identity.
venues.package08_reasoning: The row's name and official_website_url correctly identify the greyhound stadium at NE6 2XJ, but its capacity_source_url (Wikipedia's Utilita Arena Newcastle article) and programme_url (utilitaarena.co.uk) belong to a physically separate arena at NE4 7NA. Different postcodes, different locations, different real-world identity -- these are two venues, not one. Admitting this row unmodified would attach the wrong capacity and wrong programme source to the greyhound stadium. Per brief guidance this is held, not rescued, since the corrupted fields (capacity, programme_url) are not something this package can fix.
